caseNameFull: C. F. Easton, Receiver, etc., in Error v. The Chicago Hotel Company
summary: In error to the District Court of the United States for the Western District of Washington.
attorneys: Mr. Stephen A. Keenan for the plaintiff in error., Mr. Chas. W. Dorr, Mr. Aldis B. Browne, Mr. Alexander Britton and Mr. Evans Browne for the defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction on the authority of United States v. Congress Construction Co., 222 U. S. 199; Fore River Shipbuilding Co. v. Hogg, 219 U. S. 195; Louisville Trust Co. v. Knott, 191 U. S. 225; Smith v. McKay, 161 U. S. 355.

Mr. Chas. W. Dorr, Mr. Aldis B. Browne, Mr. Alexander Britton and Mr. Evans Browne for the defendants in error.
